models.label: Qwen3-4B-Instruct
models.note: This codebase carries cjkSpacing in readingStyle and CJK typography throughout, and phase 13 found 7 books with substantial CJK content and none declaring it — Chinese books are expected, and Llama-3.2-3B is materially weaker there. 4B at Q4 fits a laptop that is also running a browser. Lemonade's own catalogue names this same checkpoint and quantization (Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507-GGUF, recipe llamacpp), so it installs through the path being built.

models.label: Kokoro
models.note: Lemonade's shipped catalogue lists kokoro-v1 as checkpoint mikkoph/kokoro-onnx, recipe kokoro, size 0.354 — with no license and no digest, which is exactly the gap this manifest exists to fill. Two artifacts: the graph and the voice pack. 354 MB total is small enough that a reader will not refuse the download.
